title: RBI issues Amendment Directions on ‘Net Open Position – Revised Instructions’
description: The Reserve Bank of India had issued draft Amendment Directions on ‘Net Open Position – Revised Instructions’ on January 14, 2026, seeking inputs from Regulated Entities (REs) and other stakeholders till February 3, 2026. The draft Amendment Directions proposed to modify the instructions related to Net Open Position (NOP) and capital charge for forex risk.
